pages.title: You Cannot Make One
pages.text:
Smiths have tried. Guilds have funded it. Three ages had a serious go and every one produced something that did nothing, or killed the smith.

A rifle is an argument between forty parts, and every part is the answer to a question we no longer know how to ask.

pages.title: But You Can Feed It
pages.text:
A cartridge is a small cruelty: a pinch of the black residue, a cup of soft metal, a stone to throw, and a shape you can copy off a spent one with calipers.

You find the weapon. Then you spend the rest of your life feeding it.

Look in dungeon chests. Look deep.
